definition_zh: 供应商；卖方；摊贩；（软件）供应商
definition_en: a person or company that sells goods or services, especially one that supplies another business
core_image: 一辆货车停在工厂后门，司机把纸箱交给采购员
scene: 采购经理核对到货清单，确认原料由同一家供应商按时送到。Every week the purchasing manager checks that the same vendor delivers the raw materials on time.
sceneCN: 这里 vendor 是「供应商」（第 2 个义项：向企业长期供货的公司）；句意：采购经理每周核对，确认同一家供应商按时送来原料。

derivatives.zh: 出售；售卖，与 vendor 同出拉丁语 vendere
售卖；自动售货，由 vend 加 -ing 构成
可出售的，由 vend 加 -ible 构成

senses.title: A person who sells
senses.definition: a person or business that sells goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 出售商品或服务的个人或商家
senses.example: A vendor was selling roasted chestnuts at the corner of the square.
senses.exampleCN: 一位小贩在广场拐角处卖烤栗子。
senses.why: Vendor comes from Latin venditor, the person who sells, so the first sense is simply the seller in a deal.
senses.whyCN: vendor 来自拉丁语 venditor，即「卖的人」，所以第一个义项就是交易中卖方这一角色。

senses.title: A business supplier
senses.definition: a company that supplies goods or materials to another company
senses.definitionCN: 向另一家公司供应货物或材料的公司
senses.example: The purchasing team visited every vendor before signing the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 采购团队在签合同前拜访了每一家供应商。
senses.why: Trade between firms turned the general seller into the regular supplier that stands behind a supply chain.
senses.whyCN: 企业之间的贸易把一般的卖方固定成供应链背后的长期供应商，这是从「卖」长出的企业义。

senses.title: A market stallholder
senses.definition: a person who sells from a stall, a cart, or a small outdoor stand
senses.definitionCN: 在摊位、推车或露天小摊上卖货的人
senses.example: The fruit vendor wrapped the peaches in paper.
senses.exampleCN: 卖水果的摊贩用纸把桃子包起来。
senses.why: The street market kept the small, concrete seller beside the large firm, so the same word names the stallholder.
senses.whyCN: 街头市场保留了大企业旁边那种具体而微小的卖方，于是同一个词也指摊贩。

senses.title: A technology vendor
senses.definition: a company that sells software, hardware, or computing services
senses.definitionCN: 出售软件、硬件或计算服务的公司
senses.example: The software vendor will patch the payroll system next week.
senses.exampleCN: 软件供应商下周会修补薪资系统。
senses.why: In computing, the firm that sells and supports a product is still a seller, now of licences and updates.
senses.whyCN: 在计算机行业，出售并支持产品的公司仍然是卖方，只是卖的变成了许可证与更新服务。

senses.title: The seller of a property
senses.definition: the person or party that sells a house or land in a legal transaction
senses.definitionCN: 在房产交易中出售房屋或土地的一方
senses.example: The vendor signed the transfer deed before the buyer collected the keys.
senses.exampleCN: 卖方在买方拿钥匙之前签了过户契据。
senses.why: Property law kept the Latin seller as the formal role name on the deed, so vendor became a legal title.
senses.whyCN: 不动产法律把拉丁语的「卖者」保留为契据上的正式角色名，于是 vendor 成了一个法律称谓。

senses.title: An online seller
senses.definition: a third-party trader that sells through an online marketplace
senses.definitionCN: 通过网络平台卖货的第三方商家
senses.example: The online vendor shipped the order within two days.
senses.exampleCN: 网络卖家两天内发出了订单。
senses.why: Online marketplaces replaced the stall with a storefront page, but the selling party is still the vendor.
senses.whyCN: 网络平台用店铺页面取代了摊位，但交易中卖货的一方仍然叫 vendor。

intro.en: Vendor comes from Latin venditor, the seller, from vendere, to sell, itself a contraction of venum dare, to give for sale.
intro.cn: vendor 来自拉丁语 venditor（卖者），源于 vendere（出售），而 vendere 是 venum dare（为卖而给）的缩合形式。

items.en: Venum names a thing offered for sale.
items.cn: venum 指拿出来出售的东西。

items.en: Dare means to give, and venum dare means to give for sale.
items.cn: dare 意为给，venum dare 即「为卖而给」。

items.en: The phrase contracts into vendere, the verb to sell.
items.cn: 这个短语缩合成 vendere，即「出售」这个动词。

items.en: Venditor is the seller, the agent noun of vendere.
items.cn: venditor 是卖者，即 vendere 的施事名词。

items.en: Vendor, from vendre, to sell, names the seller in legal French.
items.cn: vendor 来自 vendre（出售），在法律法语中指卖方。

items.en: English vendor begins in deeds and trade records, and later covers software and online sellers.
items.cn: 英语 vendor 最初见于契据与商业记录，后来覆盖软件商与网络卖家。

note.en: Vendor belongs to the Latin selling family of vend, vending, and vendible, and sits near supplier and seller.
note.cn: vendor 属于拉丁语「卖」词族，与 vend、vending、vendible 同源，并与 supplier、seller 意义相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 出售货物，与 vendor 同出拉丁语 vendere

entries.definition: the business of selling goods, often through machines
entries.definitionCN: 售卖业务，常指自动售货

entries.definition: a company that provides goods to another company
entries.definitionCN: 向另一家公司供货的企业，比 vendor 更强调长期供货关系

entries.definition: a person or business that sells something
entries.definitionCN: 卖方；卖家，最中性的说法

entries.definition: a person who buys and sells goods in large amounts
entries.definitionCN: 商人；批发商，常指从事大宗买卖的人

normalIntro.en: Vendor is the selling side of a deal, from the Latin verb vendere, to sell.
normalIntro.cn: vendor 是交易中「卖」的一方，源自拉丁语动词 vendere（出售）。

normal.en: Vendor and vend share the Latin verb vendere, to sell.
normal.cn: vendor 与 vend 同出拉丁语 vendere（出售）。

normal.en: A vendor supplies goods, and a buyer pays for them.
normal.cn: 供应商供货，买方付钱，双方构成一笔交易。

normal.en: Supply chains speak of vendor selection and vendor management.
normal.cn: 供应链里会说「vendor selection」与「vendor management」这类搭配。

normal.en: A street vendor sells from a cart or a stall.
normal.cn: 街头摊贩推车或摆摊卖货。

normal.en: Compare supplier: supplier is neutral, vendor often names the seller in a contract.
normal.cn: 对比 supplier：supplier 更中性，vendor 常指合同中的卖方。

abstract.en: Picture a hand offering goods while another hand takes the coins.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手递出货品，另一只手接过钱币。

abstract.en: Picture a van unloading crates at the factory gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆货车在工厂门口卸下纸箱。

abstract.en: Picture a striped awning over a table of fruit.
abstract.cn: 想象水果摊上方有一顶条纹遮阳篷。

examples.en: The vendor agreed to deliver the parts by Friday.
examples.cn: 供应商同意在周五前交付零件。

examples.en: A street vendor sold hot noodles to the morning crowd.
examples.cn: 一位街头摊贩把热面条卖给早高峰的人群。

examples.en: The software vendor offers training for every new client.
examples.cn: 软件供应商为每位新客户提供培训。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「稳达」——货物稳定送达的卖方，就是可靠的供应商；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 venum dare（为卖而给）缩合为 vendere（出售）→ 拉丁语 venditor（卖者）→ 盎格鲁-法语 vendor → 英语 vendor，核心义「卖出货物的一方」。

sensesIntro.en: Vendor keeps the Latin sense of the seller and spreads from one trader to a firm that supplies a supply chain, a software maker, an online shop, and the seller named in a property deed.
sensesIntro.cn: vendor 保留拉丁语「卖者」的核心义，并从单个卖家扩展到供应链供应商、软件商、网络店铺以及房产契据上的出让人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a loaded van at the back door of a factory.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆满载的货车停在工厂后门。

branches.en: A single seller is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 单个卖家是最日常的义项。

branches.en: A firm that supplies another firm is the business sense.
branches.cn: 向另一家企业供货的公司是商务义项。

branches.en: A stallholder is the small-scale street sense.
branches.cn: 摊贩是小规模的街头义项。

branches.en: Software and online sellers are the modern trading senses.
branches.cn: 软件商与网络卖家是现代的买卖义项。

branches.en: The seller named in a property deed is the legal sense.
branches.cn: 房产契据上的出让人是法律义项。

intro.en: Vendor is built on the Latin verb vendere, to sell, with the agent suffix -or marking the person who sells; English also has vend and vending from the same family.
intro.cn: vendor 建在拉丁语动词 vendere（出售）之上，施事后缀 -or 标记「卖的人」；英语还有同族的 vend 与 vending。

latinIntro.en: Latin venum dare, to give for sale, contracts into vendere, to sell, and venditor names the seller.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 venum dare（为卖而给）缩合为 vendere（出售），venditor 则指卖者。

items.example: Venum names the object offered for sale.
items.exampleCN: venum 指被拿出来出售的东西。

items.example: Dare supplies the giving half of venum dare.
items.exampleCN: dare 提供 venum dare 中「给」的那一半。

items.example: Vendere is the shortened form of venum dare.
items.exampleCN: vendere 是 venum dare 的缩合形式。

items.example: Venditor is the agent noun from vendere.
items.exampleCN: venditor 是由 vendere 派生的施事名词。

items.example: Anglo-French vendor comes from vendre, to sell.
items.exampleCN: 盎格鲁-法语 vendor 来自 vendre（出售）。

items.example: English vendor keeps the legal and commercial seller.
items.exampleCN: 英语 vendor 保留了法律与商业上的卖方含义。

items.example: The suffix -or marks the person who sells.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -or 标记从事出售的人。

items.example: Vend is the short verb of the same Latin family.
items.exampleCN: vend 是同一拉丁词族中的简短动词。

items.example: Vending names the business of selling, often through machines.
items.exampleCN: vending 指售卖业务，常指通过机器售卖。

items.example: Vendible describes goods that can be sold.
items.exampleCN: vendible 描述可以卖出去的货物。

definition_zh: 备忘录；便条；内部通知；记录
definition_en: a short written note used to record information or to send a message inside an organization
core_image: 一张黄色便签贴在电脑屏幕边，上面只写三行要点
scene: 会议开始前，助理把一张写满要点的黄色便签放在经理桌上。Before the meeting, the assistant left a memo on the desk of the manager, listing the key points.
sceneCN: 这里 memo 是「办公室备忘录」（第 1 个义项：组织内部传递信息的简短书面通知）；句意：会议开始前，助理把一张写满要点的备忘录放在经理桌上。

derivatives.zh: 备忘录；正式纪要，是 memo 未被缩略的完整形式
纪念物；纪念碑，由「记忆」词根加 -ial 构成
记住；背诵，由「记忆」词根加 -ize 构成

senses.title: An office memo
senses.definition: a short written message sent to colleagues to record or announce something
senses.definitionCN: 发给同事、用来记录或通告某事的简短书面信息
senses.example: She sent a memo to all staff about the new security rules.
senses.exampleCN: 她就新的安全规定给全体员工发了一份备忘录。
senses.why: Memorandum est, it must be remembered, became the note that carries a message inside an office.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 memorandum est 意为「应被记住」，后来变成办公室里传递消息的那张纸条。

senses.title: A quick written note
senses.definition: a small piece of paper on which someone writes a reminder
senses.definitionCN: 写有提醒事项的小纸片
senses.example: He jotted the phone number on a memo and stuck it to the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 他把电话号码写在便条上，贴在屏幕边。
senses.why: The clipped form kept the everyday habit of writing something down so as not to forget it.
senses.whyCN: 缩略形式保留了日常习惯：把怕忘的事写下来，便条就是记忆的临时载体。

senses.title: A written record
senses.definition: a note that preserves the details of a meeting or an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 保存会议或协议细节的书面记录
senses.example: The memo of the meeting listed every decision and deadline.
senses.exampleCN: 会议纪要列出了每项决定和截止日期。
senses.why: A memo can serve memory by recording what was said or agreed, so it grows into the record sense.
senses.whyCN: 备忘录可以替记忆保存说过或商定的事，于是从便条长出了「记录、纪要」这一义。

senses.title: A legal memorandum
senses.definition: a formal note that sets out the terms of an agreement or the legal position of a case
senses.definitionCN: 列明协议条款或案件法律立场的正式书面说明
senses.example: The lawyer prepared a memo on the risks of the merger.
senses.exampleCN: 律师就并购风险准备了一份备忘录。
senses.why: Law and diplomacy kept the full Latin word for a document that must be remembered and consulted.
senses.whyCN: 法律与外交保留了拉丁语全形，用来指必须留存并随时查阅的正式文件。

senses.title: An electronic memo
senses.definition: a memo stored and sent in an email system or a computer file
senses.definitionCN: 保存在电子邮件系统或电脑文件中的备忘录
senses.example: The system files every memo under the name of its author.
senses.exampleCN: 系统按作者姓名归档每一份备忘录。
senses.why: The same short message moved from paper to the inbox, but the name memo stayed.
senses.whyCN: 同一种简短消息从纸张搬进了收件箱，但 memo 这个名字留了下来。

intro.en: Memo is a clipped form of memorandum, from Latin memorandum est, it must be remembered, a gerundive of memorare, to bring to mind.
intro.cn: memo 是 memorandum 的缩略形式；memorandum 来自拉丁语 memorandum est（应被记住），是 memorare（使想起）的动形词。

items.en: Memor means mindful, the adjective behind the whole family.
items.cn: memor 意为「记得的、留心的」，是整个词族的形容词源头。

items.en: Memorare means to bring something to mind or to mention it.
items.cn: memorare 意为使某事回到心中，或提及它。

items.en: Memorandum est means it must be remembered, the heading of a note.
items.cn: memorandum est 意为「应被记住」，常作便笺的抬头。

items.en: English memorandum names a note written to preserve a fact.
items.cn: 英语 memorandum 指为保存事实而写的记录。

items.en: Speakers clip memorandum into memo for speed.
items.cn: 为了省力，说话者把 memorandum 缩略成 memo。

items.en: Memo covers office notices, legal notes, and email headers.
items.cn: 现代英语中，memo 覆盖办公室通知、法律备忘与邮件标题。

note.en: Memo sits in the Latin memory family of memorandum, memorial, and memorize, and near the everyday note and notice.
note.cn: memo 属于拉丁语「记忆」词族，与 memorandum、memorial、memorize 同源，并与日常的 note、notice 意义相邻。

entries.definition: a formal note or a written record
entries.definitionCN: 正式备忘录或书面记录，是 memo 的完整形式

entries.definition: a written record of what was said at a meeting
entries.definitionCN: 会议记录，通常用复数 minutes

normalIntro.en: Memo is a clipped memorandum, the Latin note that must be remembered.
normalIntro.cn: memo 是 memorandum 的缩略，本义是「应被记住的」那张纸条。

normal.en: Memo and memorandum share the Latin root memor, mindful.
normal.cn: memo 与 memorandum 同出拉丁语 memor（记得的）。

normal.en: An internal memo carries one message to many desks.
normal.cn: 内部备忘录把同一条消息送到许多张办公桌。

normal.en: A memo pad keeps small notes within reach.
normal.cn: 便笺本让零散的小笔记触手可及。

normal.en: A credit memo adjusts a customer account in accounting.
normal.cn: 在会计中，贷项通知单用来调整客户账户。

normal.en: Compare memorandum: the full form sounds formal, memo sounds everyday.
normal.cn: 对比 memorandum：完整形式更正式，memo 更日常。

abstract.en: Picture a yellow sticky note on the edge of a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象一张黄色便签贴在屏幕边缘。

abstract.en: Picture a folded note kept in a coat pocket.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折好的便条放在外套口袋里。

abstract.en: Picture a ring binder of meeting records on a shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象书架上有一本装订好的会议记录。

examples.en: Please put the main points of the call in a short memo.
examples.cn: 请把通话要点写进一份简短备忘录。

examples.en: The memo on the notice board reminded everyone of the fire drill.
examples.cn: 公告栏上的备忘录提醒大家有消防演习。

examples.en: She keeps a memo pad beside the phone for quick notes.
examples.cn: 她在电话旁放了一本便笺，方便快速记录。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「麦某」——提醒小麦某件事的小纸条；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 memor（记得的）→ memorare（使想起）→ 动形词 memorandum（应被记住之事）→ 英语缩略为 memo，核心义「替记忆留痕的短笺」。

sensesIntro.en: Memo starts as a note that must be remembered, then becomes the everyday reminder, the formal record, the legal note, and the message in an inbox.
sensesIntro.cn: memo 从「应被记住的纸条」出发，依次引申为随手便条、正式记录、法律备忘与收件箱里的电子留言。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a yellow note stuck beside a computer screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张贴在电脑屏幕旁的黄色便签。

branches.en: The office memo is the central modern sense.
branches.cn: 办公室备忘录是核心的现代义项。

branches.en: The quick note is the small personal sense.
branches.cn: 随手便条是私人化的细小义项。

branches.en: The record sense keeps the details of a meeting.
The legal memorandum is the formal document sense.
branches.cn: 法律备忘录是正式文件义项。

branches.en: Paper and electronic memos carry the same kind of message.
branches.cn: 纸质与电子备忘录传递的是同一类消息。

intro.en: Memo is a clipped form of memorandum, built on the Latin memory family of memor and memorare, with -andum marking the thing that must be remembered.
intro.cn: memo 是 memorandum 的缩略，建在拉丁语「记忆」词族 memor 与 memorare 之上，-andum 标记「应被记住之事」。

latinIntro.en: Latin memor means mindful, memorare means to bring to mind, and memorandum means that which must be remembered.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 memor 意为记得的，memorare 意为使想起，memorandum 意为应被记住之事。

items.example: Memor is the adjective at the root of the family.
items.exampleCN: memor 是整个词族根部的形容词。

items.example: Memorare gives the verb of remembering.
items.exampleCN: memorare 提供「记住」这个动词。

items.example: Memorandum is the gerundive form of memorare.
items.exampleCN: memorandum 是 memorare 的动形词形式。

items.meaning: gerundive ending, what must be done
items.meaningCN: 动形词词尾，表示「必须被……之事」
items.example: The ending -andum builds memorandum from memorare.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -andum 让 memorare 构成 memorandum。

items.example: Memo clips the long Latin form for daily use.
items.exampleCN: memo 把冗长的拉丁形式缩略，供日常使用。

items.example: Memory keeps the same root in everyday English.
items.exampleCN: memory 在日常英语中保留同一词根。

items.example: Memorize adds the verb suffix -ize.
items.exampleCN: memorize 加了动词后缀 -ize。

items.example: Memorable adds the adjective suffix -able.
items.exampleCN: memorable 加了形容词后缀 -able。

items.example: Memorial turns the root into a thing that remembers.
items.exampleCN: memorial 把词根变成承载记忆的事物。

items.example: The suffix -ize forms memorize from memory.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ize 让 memory 构成 memorize。

definition_en: the state of having more than is needed, or a job that is no longer required and is therefore cut
core_image: 流水线旁多站了两个人，机器照常运转，他们却无事可做
scene: 公司合并后两个部门做同样的事，管理层只好裁掉多余的岗位。After the merger, the two departments did the same work, so managers had to announce a round of redundancies.
sceneCN: 这里 redundancy 是「裁员；被裁的岗位」（第 2 个义项：雇主认为不再需要而撤销的职位）；句意：合并后两个部门工作重复，管理层只好宣布一轮裁员。

derivatives.zh: 多余的；冗余的；被裁员的，是 redundancy 的形容词形式
多余地；冗余地，由 redundant 加 -ly 构成
多余；冗余，与 redundancy 并行的名词形式

senses.title: More than is needed
senses.definition: the state of having more of something than is necessary
senses.definitionCN: 某物的数量超出所需的状态
senses.example: The report found redundancy in the approval process.
senses.exampleCN: 报告发现审批流程存在冗余。
senses.why: Redundare means to overflow, so redundancy first names an excess that spills over what is needed.
senses.whyCN: redundare 意为溢出，所以 redundancy 首先指超出所需、像水一样漫出来的那部分。

senses.title: A job that is cut
senses.definition: a job that an employer decides is no longer needed, usually with the worker losing it
senses.definitionCN: 雇主认定不再需要而撤销的职位，通常意味着员工失去工作
senses.example: The restructuring led to a wave of redundancies.
senses.exampleCN: 这次重组引发了一轮裁员。
senses.why: In British labour language the overflowing part became the post that is removed, and then the dismissal itself.
senses.whyCN: 在英式劳工用语里，溢出的那部分先变成被撤掉的岗位，再转指裁员这件事本身。

senses.title: Needless repetition
senses.definition: the use of more words than are needed to make a point
senses.definitionCN: 为表达一个意思而使用了过多的词
senses.example: The paragraph suffers from redundancy because the same point appears three times.
senses.exampleCN: 这段文字有赘述毛病，同一个意思出现了三次。
senses.why: Overflow applied to language is the extra word that adds nothing to the meaning.
senses.whyCN: 把「溢出」用到语言上，就是那些对意思毫无贡献的多余字词。

senses.title: A backup in a system
senses.definition: extra parts or paths built into a system so that one failure cannot stop it
senses.definitionCN: 系统里额外配置的部件或通路，使单点故障无法让系统停摆
senses.example: Engineers built redundancy into the control system so that one failure cannot stop the plant.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师在控制系统中加入冗余，使单点故障无法让工厂停机。
senses.why: Engineering takes the overflow as a deliberate spare that keeps a system running.
senses.whyCN: 工程学把「溢出」变成有意准备的备份，用来维持系统运转。

senses.title: Repeated data
senses.definition: information that is repeated in a message or a data set and can be removed without loss
senses.definitionCN: 消息或数据集中重复出现、删去也不损失信息的部分
senses.example: Compression removes redundancy from the data stream.
senses.exampleCN: 压缩会去掉数据流中的冗余。
senses.why: Information theory measures the overflow as the part of a message that repeats what is already known.
senses.whyCN: 信息论把「溢出」量化为消息中重复已知内容的那一部分。

intro.en: Redundancy comes from Latin redundantia, an overflow, from redundare, to overflow or run back, built on unda, a wave.
intro.cn: redundancy 来自拉丁语 redundantia（溢出），源于 redundare（溢出、回流），其词根是 unda（波浪）。

items.en: Unda means a wave or a body of water.
items.cn: unda 意为波浪或一片水。

items.en: Redundare means to overflow or to run back like a wave.
items.cn: redundare 意为溢出，或像波浪一样回流。
redundantia 指溢出的状态或溢出的东西。

items.en: English redundancy first names excess in speech and writing.
items.cn: 英语 redundancy 最早指言语和写作中的多余。

items.en: British employers use redundancy for jobs that are no longer needed.
items.cn: 英国雇主用 redundancy 指不再需要的岗位以及由此产生的裁员。

items.en: The word also covers backup systems and repeated data.
items.cn: 这个词还覆盖备份系统与重复数据。

note.en: Redundancy belongs to the wave family of redundant and redundance, and sits near surplus, excess, and the American layoff.
note.cn: redundancy 属于「波浪、溢出」词族，与 redundant、redundance 同源，并与 surplus、excess 以及美式 layoff 意义相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 多余的；冗余的，是 redundancy 的形容词
多余的状态，与 redundancy 意义接近

entries.definition: in a way that is more than needed
an amount left over after needs are met
entries.definitionCN: 剩余；过剩，强调满足需求后剩下的量

entries.definition: an amount that is more than necessary
entries.definitionCN: 过量；过度，最一般化的「超出」

entries.definition: the dismissal of workers because they are not needed
entries.definitionCN: 裁员，美式说法，对应英式 redundancy 的裁员义

normalIntro.en: Redundancy carries the Latin image of a wave that overflows its container.
normalIntro.cn: redundancy 带着拉丁语意象：波浪涨满，溢出容器。

normal.en: Redundancy and redundant share the Latin image of a wave that overflows.
normal.cn: redundancy 与 redundant 共享「波浪溢出」的拉丁意象。

normal.en: Redundancy pay is the money offered when a post is cut.
normal.cn: 裁员补偿金是岗位被撤时给出的钱。

normal.en: Voluntary redundancy means workers choose to leave.
normal.cn: 自愿裁员指员工自己选择离开。

normal.en: A backup generator is redundancy built into a building.
normal.cn: 备用发电机就是楼里预先配置的冗余。

normal.en: Repeated words in a sentence are redundancy in style.
normal.cn: 句子里重复的词就是文体上的冗余。

abstract.en: Picture a cup so full that water runs down the side.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子太满，水从杯壁流下来。

abstract.en: Picture two workers standing idle beside a moving line.
abstract.cn: 想象两名工人站在运转的流水线旁无事可做。

abstract.en: Picture the same sentence written twice on one page.
abstract.cn: 想象同一句话在一页纸上写了两遍。

examples.en: The company offered redundancy pay to the workers who left.
examples.cn: 公司向离职员工提供了裁员补偿金。

examples.en: Voluntary redundancy avoided forced job losses at the plant.
examples.cn: 自愿裁员让工厂避免了强制性的岗位流失。

examples.en: A good design adds redundancy so that a single fault does not stop the machine.
examples.cn: 好的设计会加入冗余，使单一故障不会让机器停转。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞丹登西」——人太多，岗位像水一样溢出来了；谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 unda（波浪）→ redundare（溢出、回流）→ redundantia（溢出）→ 英语 redundancy，核心义「超出所需而溢出的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Redundancy begins as an overflow, then names excess words, a post that is cut, a deliberate backup, and repeated data.
sensesIntro.cn: redundancy 从「溢出」出发，依次指多余的字词、被撤掉的岗位、有意设置的备份以及重复的数据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water rising above the rim of a full cup.
core.cn: 核心意象：水涨过满杯的杯口。

branches.en: The general excess is the core sense.
branches.cn: 一般性的多余是核心义项。

branches.en: The cut post is the British labour sense.
branches.cn: 被撤岗位是英式劳工义项。

branches.en: Excess words form the stylistic sense.
branches.cn: 多余字词构成文体义项。

branches.en: Backups and repeated data are the technical senses.
branches.cn: 备份与重复数据是技术义项。

branches.en: A post becomes redundant when it overflows the real need for work.
branches.cn: 岗位超出实际工作所需时，就成了可被裁掉的冗余。

intro.en: Redundancy is built from Latin unda, a wave, through redundare, to overflow, with the noun suffix -ancy marking the resulting state.
intro.cn: redundancy 由拉丁语 unda（波浪）经 redundare（溢出）构成，名词后缀 -ancy 标记由此形成的状态。

latinIntro.en: Latin unda means a wave, redundare means to overflow, and redundantia means an overflow.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unda 意为波浪，redundare 意为溢出，redundantia 意为溢出之物或溢出状态。

items.example: Unda gives the wave image behind the word.
items.exampleCN: unda 提供这个词背后的波浪意象。

items.example: Redundare is the flooding verb at the centre.
items.exampleCN: redundare 是处于中心的「溢出」动词。

items.example: Redundantia turns the verb into a state.
items.exampleCN: redundantia 把动词变成状态名词。

items.example: Redundant describes what overflows the need.
items.exampleCN: redundant 描述超出所需的东西。

items.example: Redundancy keeps the noun state and the job sense.
items.exampleCN: redundancy 保留名词状态义与裁员义。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ancy forms redundancy from redundant.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ancy 让 redundant 构成 redundancy。

items.meaningCN: 表示「处于……的」的形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ant forms redundant from the Latin verb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ant 从拉丁动词构成 redundant。

items.example: Redundantly adds the adverb ending -ly.
items.exampleCN: redundantly 加了副词词尾 -ly。

items.example: Redundance is the older parallel noun.
items.exampleCN: redundance 是较旧的并行名词形式。

items.meaningCN: 表示「以……方式」的副词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ly forms redundantly.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 redundantly。
